public_rationale: The claim says generative AI was making money for nobody, and gives a reason. The effect it describes was false when he wrote it. In the quarter ending April 2024, Nvidia reported $14.9 billion of GAAP net income. Its CEO said record data center growth came from demand for generative AI. Microsoft said AI services added 7 points to Azure's growth in the quarter ending March 2024. So some companies were making a lot of money from generative AI. Whether firms that adopt generative AI gained extra revenue, the stated cause, is a separate and harder question. It is not needed, because the claimed outcome itself fails.
limitations: Nvidia figures come from a news report of the release, not the release itself.
The reasoning about adopting firms was not tested directly.
He may have meant only firms that adopt generative AI, but his words say 'anybody'.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is not making money for anyone because it does not generate extra revenue for companies using it.

statement.excerpt: In plain English: generative AI isn't making any money for anybody because it doesn't actually make companies that use it any extra money.

from_speaker: generative AI isn't making any money
because it doesn't actually make companies that use it any extra money
our_interpretation: Plain reading: as of the post (July 2024), no company was earning money from generative AI, and the stated reason is that adopting firms gained no extra revenue.
'Anybody' covers sellers of generative AI products and infrastructure, not only the firms that adopt it.
He named no period. I use the most recent period reported before the post, 2024-01-01 to 2024-07-08.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence that, in early to mid 2024, firms selling generative AI products or infrastructure made no meaningful revenue or profit from it, and that adopting firms saw no extra revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Company-reported results from the first half of 2024 showing that a firm earned substantial revenue or profit attributed to generative AI demand. That would make the claimed effect ('isn't making any money for anybody') false.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia's GAAP net income for Q1 FY 2025 was $14.881 billion, up 21% from $12.285 billion in the previous quarter and up a whopping 628% from $2.043 billion in the same quarter a year before.
evidence.locator: paragraph after Q1 intro ('Nvidia reported a record quarterly revenue')
evidence.explanation: Nvidia earned $14.9 billion of GAAP net income in the quarter ending April 2024. Read with e2, this shows a company making a lot of money from generative AI.

evidence.excerpt: "Our datacenter growth was fueled by strong and accelerating demand for generative AI training and inference on the Hopper platform," said Jensen Huang
evidence.locator: section Datacenter, quote from Jensen Huang
evidence.explanation: The company attributes its record data center growth to generative AI demand. That ties the profit in e1 to generative AI.

evidence.excerpt: Inside of the Azure growth, 7 percentage points were related to AI, up from 6 points of impact in the previous quarter.
evidence.explanation: Microsoft said AI services added 7 points to Azure's 31% growth in the quarter ending March 2024. That is AI revenue for a cloud provider.
